notes: The app is now called FlowAlbum, with a new logo, the slogan "Your stories, redesigned in a click" and a new app icon
Photos is a screen of its own for organizing photos, with a Pages button that peeks at a story's pages, and a calm Design album strip with the split slider
A tag bar that floats above the photos you select: move it, resize it, and see each shortcut letter (Alternatives is now A)
Rename an album by double-clicking its name or with the pencil in All albums; its folder is renamed to match
